    Operators¶

    Every transformation operator (versor) you can add to a scene, together with its visualization style class, the style parameters, and a static inline example. Each example is rendered serverlessly via display_snapshot().

    For the underlying data classes and algebra coverage, see operators.md under the geometry section.

    In [1]:
    Copied! 
    import math

from pytanga.geometry import (
    Dilator,
    Direction,
    GeneralRotor,
    Inversion,
    Motor,
    Point,
    ReflectionLine,
    ReflectionPlane,
    ReflectionPoint,
    Rotor,
    Translator,
)
from pytanga.viz import CameraConfig3d, ReflectionPlaneStyle, Visualizer

_NOTE = "You can interactively rotate, pan, and zoom this view."


def show(entity, height=340, **kwargs):
    # Render a single operator in a fresh scene, inline and serverless.
    viz = Visualizer(
        title="Operators - " + type(entity).__name__,
        add_default_axes=False,
        annotation=_NOTE,
        camera=CameraConfig3d(position=(2.5, 1.5, 3), target=(0, 0, 0)),
    )
    viz.add(entity, **kwargs)
    return viz.display_snapshot(height=height)
    import math from pytanga.geometry import ( Dilator, Direction, GeneralRotor, Inversion, Motor, Point, ReflectionLine, ReflectionPlane, ReflectionPoint, Rotor, Translator, ) from pytanga.viz import CameraConfig3d, ReflectionPlaneStyle, Visualizer _NOTE = "You can interactively rotate, pan, and zoom this view." def show(entity, height=340, **kwargs): # Render a single operator in a fresh scene, inline and serverless. viz = Visualizer( title="Operators - " + type(entity).__name__, add_default_axes=False, annotation=_NOTE, camera=CameraConfig3d(position=(2.5, 1.5, 3), target=(0, 0, 0)), ) viz.add(entity, **kwargs) return viz.display_snapshot(height=height)

    ReflectionPlane¶

    Reflection in a plane through the origin. Reflection is an alias.

    Field Type Description
    color str CSS colour
    opacity float 0-1
    extent float Drawn size in world units
    In [2]:
    Copied! 
    show(
    ReflectionPlane(Direction(0, 0, 1)),
    style=ReflectionPlaneStyle(extent=3.0),
)
    show( ReflectionPlane(Direction(0, 0, 1)), style=ReflectionPlaneStyle(extent=3.0), )
    Out[2]:

    ReflectionLine¶

    Reflection about a line through the origin.

    Field Type Description
    color str CSS colour
    opacity float 0-1
    length float Drawn length in world units
    thickness float Line width in screen pixels
    In [3]:
    Copied! 
    show(ReflectionLine(Direction(0, 0, 1)))
    show(ReflectionLine(Direction(0, 0, 1)))
    Out[3]:

    ReflectionPoint¶

    Reflection about a point (point inversion through the given center).

    ReflectionPointStyle is defined in pytanga.viz._styles but is not exported from the top-level pytanga.viz namespace.

    Field Type Description
    color str CSS colour
    opacity float 0-1
    extent float Drawn size in world units
    In [4]:
    Copied! 
    show(ReflectionPoint(Point(0, 0, 0)))
    show(ReflectionPoint(Point(0, 0, 0)))
    Out[4]:

    Inversion¶

    Inversion in a sphere centered at the origin.

    Field Type Description
    color str CSS colour
    opacity float 0-1
    In [5]:
    Copied! 
    show(Inversion(Point(0, 0, 0)))
    show(Inversion(Point(0, 0, 0)))
    Out[5]:

    Rotor¶

    A rotation (disc arc plus axis line).

    Field Type Description
    color str CSS colour
    opacity float 0-1
    disc_radius float Radius of the rotation disc
    In [6]:
    Copied! 
    show(Rotor(angle=math.pi / 2, axis=Direction(0, 0, 1)))
    show(Rotor(angle=math.pi / 2, axis=Direction(0, 0, 1)))
    Out[6]:

    Translator¶

    A translation (3D arrow).

    Field Type Description
    color str CSS colour
    opacity float 0-1
    length float Arrow length in world units
    In [7]:
    Copied! 
    show(Translator(vector=Direction(2, 0, 0)), color="#44aaff")
    show(Translator(vector=Direction(2, 0, 0)), color="#44aaff")
    Out[7]:

    Dilator¶

    A uniform scaling (concentric expanding rings).

    Field Type Description
    color str CSS colour
    opacity float 0-1
    ring_count int Number of concentric rings
    max_radius float Radius of the outermost ring
    In [8]:
    Copied! 
    show(
    Dilator(factor=2.0, origin=Point(0, 0, 0)),
    color="#ffcc44",
)
    show( Dilator(factor=2.0, origin=Point(0, 0, 0)), color="#ffcc44", )
    Out[8]:

    Motor¶

    A rigid body motion (screw): rotation about a displaced axis plus a translation along that axis. See the decomposition for the maths.

    Field Type Description
    color str CSS colour
    opacity float 0-1
    In [9]:
    Copied! 
    show(
    Motor(
        rotor=Rotor(angle=math.pi / 2, axis=Direction(0, 0, 1)),
        translator=Translator(vector=Direction(1, 1, 1)),
    ),
    color="#ff66cc",
)
    show( Motor( rotor=Rotor(angle=math.pi / 2, axis=Direction(0, 0, 1)), translator=Translator(vector=Direction(1, 1, 1)), ), color="#ff66cc", )
    Out[9]:

    GeneralRotor¶

    A rotation about an axis that does not pass through the origin.

    Field Type Description
    color str CSS colour
    opacity float 0-1
    In [10]:
    Copied! 
    show(
    GeneralRotor(
        angle=0.5,
        axis=Direction(0, 0, 1),
        origin=Point(1, 0, 0),
    ),
)
    show( GeneralRotor( angle=0.5, axis=Direction(0, 0, 1), origin=Point(1, 0, 0), ), )
    Out[10]:
